thread:
Kira: FYI ACME security team asked if we can run a fully offline POC (no egress) in their SOC2 datacenter. Scope: deploy + run model, perf target 150 qps, and demonstrate upgrade + rollback. They9re requesting packaging details, patch cadence, and a signed artifact workflow.
Mason: Clarify: customer provides 4x A100 + isolated network, correct? Also want proof of SBOM, signed manifests, and a short attestation for their compliance packet.
Kira: Correct. Hardware provided. Timeline: target POC window May 6-20. Procurement wants pricing ballpark this week.
Priya: Packaging constraints we support: single offline bundle (tar.gz) with manifest, sbom, and detached signature file. Installer runs locally and accepts a local activation token. No outbound calls required. Typical compressed bundle depends on model: base image w/o weights ~3GB, weights add 7-12GB. We can offer slimmer quantized weights (~6-8GB) on request.
Rafael: Security requirements from ACME: HSM/PKCS11 for signing keys, FIPS mode support, and ability to host all logs locally (no telemetry). They also want documented CVE triage timelines and a chain-of-custody note for signed bundles.
Mason: For patches: we can do diff updates (delta patches) for minor fixes; full signed bundles for majors. Suggested cadence: security patches monthly, delta feature patches every 6 weeks, full releases quarterly. Can we guarantee monthly security-only patches?
Priya: Yes. We can commit to monthly security hotfixes and define SLA: emergency triage in 72h, signed hotfix bundle within 7 days. Standard security rollouts monthly. Delta feature patches every 6 weeks; majors quarterly (manual apply).
Kira: ACME asked about licensing/pricing: 12-month reserved capacity + on-prem platform license + premium support. Need a quick ballpark for procurement.
Mason: Rough estimate: reserved capacity for 4x A100 ~ $38k/month, platform license one-time for 12mo term ~$70k, plus support/attestation add-on ~$12k/yr. Note: add export-control review and EULA addendum for on-prem.
Rafael: Attestation: I9ll draft a 2-page security attestation covering offline install flow, key management (we sign in our HSM, provide detached signature), SBOM availability, FIPS mode, and CVE response SLA. Will include steps for verifying signature locally.
Priya: Installer UX: offline flow would be: 1) customer copies bundle onto host 2) run `sudo ./redwood-offline-installer install --bundle ./redwood-offline-1.3.0.tar.gz --token-file /path/token.txt` 3) installer validates signature against provided public cert and validates sbom checksum 4) performs install and writes local audit log. Rollback via `--rollback-to ./redwood-offline-1.2.9.tar.gz`.
Mason: Operational note: we will not collect telemetry; only optional syslog export. Provide guidance for local monitoring and retention.
contracts-bot: Heads-up: on-prem deployment triggers export-control review. Send target countries and use-case.
Kira: Next steps: Priya -> produce a sample signed bundle + README showing install/rollback by Tue EOD. Rafael -> attestation draft Tue. Mason -> send ballpark pricing to ACME procurement today. I'll schedule kickoff call with ACME for Thu 9am PST.
Mason: Sending ballpark now. Will include caveats re: final quote after export/legal review. :thumbsup:
Rafael: Also will include an appendix on chain-of-custody and who signs artifacts.
Kira: Thanks team — keep comments brief in the channel so we can share the summary with ACME.
